official.deadline_note: The scholarship is open from 10/02/2026 and closes 31/12/2027, for new international students commencing any future 2026/2027 intake. There is no separate scholarship deadline because consideration is automatic with the course application; the practical deadline is accepting the offer and paying the reduced deposit by the due date in your Letter of Offer.
official.application_cycle: Open 10 February 2026 to 31 December 2027, for 2026 and 2027 intakes
official.status_note: La Trobe lists the scholarship Status as Open, with an opening date of 10/02/2026 and a closing date of 31/12/2027. The page was last edited 10 Oct 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Amount: Up to 25% reduction in course fees. How is it paid: this scholarship will be applied from the first semester as an upfront discount to annual tuition fees for the duration of the course. In Sydney, this scholarship will be applied from the second semester as a discount to annual tuition fees for the duration of the course.
official.funding_period: annual tuition discount for the duration of the course
benefits: Up to 25% reduction in course fees.
20% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the course for a WAM of 60 to 74.9 (ATAR equivalent 60 to 74).
25% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the course for a WAM of 75 or above (ATAR equivalent 75+).
Can be combined with the Early Acceptance Grant to form a discount on first-year tuition fees, subject to all conditions being met for both offers.
eligibility: Be a citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand and be applying to start an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program.
Be a new international student commencing your course for any future 2026/2027 intake.
Apply to a program in the List of eligible courses.
Not be a humanitarian or other permanent visa holder.

Meet all entry requirements and commence your studies at any La Trobe University campus in Australia, and have passed the Genuine Student assessment, including financial checks, before you can be considered.
requirements: Maintain a full-time enrolment at one of the La Trobe University campuses in Australia and satisfactory academic progress during your studies.
Meet all conditions outlined in the Letter of Offer and accept the offer by paying the reduced deposit to confirm the scholarship.
The scholarship may not be deferred to future intakes or years; if you are unable to secure a student visa for that intake, the scholarship offer may be revoked.
Failure to meet conditions and pay the acceptance deposit on time may result in withdrawal of the scholarship.
documents: Offer of admission to an approved course on the List of eligible courses.
Evidence of meeting all entry requirements for the program.
Completion of the Genuine Student assessment, including financial checks.
Evidence of full fee-paying, non-sponsored status.
selection_criteria: Selected by the University based on your weighted average mark (WAM) and the overall eligibility of the course.
WAM 60 to 74.9 (ATAR equivalent 60 to 74) receives the La Trobe High Achiever Scholarship at 20%.
WAM 75 or above (ATAR equivalent 75+) receives the La Trobe High Achiever Scholarship at 25%.
Scholarships are limited and awarded on a first-come, first-served basis; the percentage awarded is included in the Letter of Offer.
coverage: 20% of annual tuition fees for the duration of the course (WAM 60 to 74.9).
25% of annual tuition fees for the duration of the course (WAM 75 or above).
Applied as an upfront discount from the first semester at Victorian campuses and from the second semester at Sydney campus.
application_method: Check that your intended course appears in the List of eligible courses.
Submit a standard application for admission to that course - no separate scholarship application is required.
Meet all conditions in the Letter of Offer and accept the offer by paying the required deposit.
The scholarship percentage appears in the Letter of Offer.
official.application_route: Apply for an approved course from La Trobe's List of eligible courses - consideration is automatic and the awarded percentage is stated in your Letter of Offer.

applicant_utility.summary: There is no scholarship form to fill in: La Trobe considers you automatically once you apply to a course on its List of eligible courses, and the percentage you are awarded - 20% or 25% - is simply stated in your Letter of Offer. The size of the discount is set by your weighted average mark, with 60 to 74.9 earning 20% and 75 or above earning 25%, so your WAM directly determines your money. Timing is the real trap: you must accept the offer and pay the reduced deposit by the due date or the scholarship can be withdrawn, and the offer cannot be deferred to a later intake or revoked if you cannot get a student visa for that intake. Where you study changes when the discount starts - Victorian campuses get it as an upfront reduction from the first semester, while Sydney only gets it from the second semester. If you also hold the Early Acceptance Grant you can combine the two into a single first-year discount, provided you meet the conditions of both.
applicant_utility.best_fit: New full fee-paying international coursework applicants with a WAM of 60 or above (ATAR equivalent 60+) applying to an eligible course at an Australian La Trobe campus.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your intended course is on La Trobe's List of eligible courses before applying - off-list courses get nothing
Work out your WAM, not just your raw marks: it weights each subject by credit point value
Confirm you are a full fee-paying, non-sponsored student and not a humanitarian or permanent visa holder
Be ready for the Genuine Student assessment, including the financial checks, which must be passed before you are even considered
Budget for the reduced acceptance deposit and be ready to pay it by the due date in your Letter of Offer
Confirm your campus, since Sydney students only receive the discount from the second semester
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a course that is not on the List of eligible courses
Being a humanitarian or other permanent visa holder, which is an exclusion
Being sponsored rather than full fee-paying, which is an exclusion
Failing the Genuine Student assessment including financial checks, which blocks consideration entirely
Not paying the acceptance deposit by the due date, which can lead to withdrawal of the scholarship
Requesting a deferral to a future intake, which the scholarship does not allow
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 75% to 80% of annual tuition fees, plus all living costs, accommodation, Overseas Student Health Cover, flights and visa costs. At Sydney campus you also pay full first-semester fees before the discount begins.
document_audit: The key document is your Letter of Offer - it is where the awarded percentage and the deposit due date actually appear, so read it rather than assuming the headline 25%
You must be able to evidence full fee-paying, non-sponsored status, and the Genuine Student assessment includes financial checks
The WAM is calculated on all subjects completed weighted by credit point value, so a partial transcript may not show your true position
If you hold the Early Acceptance Grant, both offers' conditions must be met for the combined first-year discount to apply
alerts: Scholarships are limited and awarded on a first-come, first-served basis, so early application genuinely matters even though there is no separate deadline
The offer cannot be deferred to future intakes or years, and may be revoked if you cannot secure a student visa for that intake
Failure to meet conditions or pay the acceptance deposit on time may result in withdrawal of the scholarship
Sydney campus applicants receive the discount only from the second semester, so first-semester cash flow differs by campus
Recipients must maintain full-time enrolment and satisfactory academic progress for the duration
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to an approved course on the List of eligible courses, pass the Genuine Student assessment, then accept the Letter of Offer and pay the reduced deposit by the due date to confirm the scholarship.
